title: Mobile profile screen in dark and light themes with activity feed and avatar tab (Whop)
attribution_visible_in_image: In-mockup content shows 'Whop' as the product and 'Ilya Miskov @ilyamiskov' as the profile. Not confirmed as the creator.
contains_third_party_content: Product name and logo (Whop), photos, profile avatar.

observed.layout: Two phone screens: dark (left) and light (right), same structure. Top: header art (canyon in dark, pale dunes in light), back button, share and settings icon buttons, an 'Edit profile' pill. Avatar with a green online dot; name 'Ilya Miskov' with an orange badge; handle; bio 'Human interface designer at Whop'; meta rows (location, join date, Links link, birthday); two outlined stat chips ('3 whops owned', '23 whops joined'); 'Activity' header with a 'Sort' dropdown; a feed item (author, views 1,483, time 45m, breadcrumb 'in Design Cave / Photos', title 'Whop Sign in flow', subtitle) with a large media preview. Bottom tab bar: home, search, chat, bell with a '2' badge, cube, and the user's avatar as a highlighted tab.
observed.hierarchy: Avatar and name, then stat chips, then the feed.
observed.typography: Neutral sans with medium-weight titles and small grey meta text. Unconfirmed.
observed.materials: Dark: near-black with soft highlights. Light: white with soft shadows and a gradient fade under the header art.

interpretation.aesthetic: Polished community-app profile with strong theme parity.
implementation_notes: Theme parity through tokens: surface, text, border and header art swap.
Header art fades into the surface with a gradient mask.
Avatar-as-tab: the profile tab shows the user's own image and a highlighted tile.

concept_work.essence: A complete profile screen that behaves the same in light and dark and ties identity to community activity.
what_makes_it_work: Breadcrumb context on feed items links activity to communities.
Stat chips summarize membership at a glance.
The avatar tab connects navigation to this screen.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Handle and location/date meta text measure about 2.6-3.5:1 in both themes.
No loading, empty or error states shown.

shared_tokens: orange badge and indigo counts as small accents
links: The 'whops owned / joined' chips and the feed breadcrumbs both point to communities.
The avatar tab mirrors the avatar on the screen, linking navigation and profile.
The bell badge links to notifications elsewhere in the app.

approach: Gradient mask under the header art
Standard list and tab bar components

pattern.name: Profile screen: identity header, stat chips, activity feed, avatar-as-active-tab
use_when: Community or social apps with membership and content
must_preserve: Avatar tab as the active indicator
adaptation_examples: Marketplace seller profile: chips become 'products' and 'sales', feed becomes listings.
Learning platform: chips show courses, feed shows lessons.

lessons: Theme parity means the same structure with only tokens changing.
Link feed items to the communities that contain them.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: orange from the header art and the name badge (medians)
magenta in the dark header art
measured.color_roles: Neutral surfaces in both themes; orange appears in header art and the badge; indigo marks counts and links; green marks status.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A clear community profile with identity, membership and activity.
Balanced hierarchy and refined surfaces in both themes.
Profile and tab-bar conventions are followed closely, including badges and status.
Sort control, badges, status dot and active tab are shown; loading and empty states are not.
Light and dark share structure, spacing, icon weight and component styling exactly.
A well-executed but conventional social profile.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 7.79:1; secondary text min 2.64:1; icon min 3.74:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
